expectedRealization.rationale: Hog cycle recovery, if real, requires price/cost/supply normalization over multiple months rather than a one-week policy bounce.

changeHypothesis.summary: Hog prices collapsed into industry-wide losses and triggered the highest official warning plus reserve purchases. The recent 20d price stabilization was not enough to establish an earnings bottom because even low-cost 牧原's Q1-reported economics were already stale relative to June spot prices.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: A genuine trough requires sustained below-cost pressure and capacity exit, not only reserve purchases.
disconfirmingEvidence: June hog prices were below 牧原's then-reported full cost.
Q1 profit remained a stale high-price-cycle artifact.
All major breeder stocks were still deeply weak over 60d.

causalChain.mechanism: Persistent prices below full cost pressure weak operators and eventually reduce supply.
causalChain.failureMode: support/rebound arrives before meaningful capacity exit

causalChain.mechanism: Lower future supply can reset the cycle after a lag.
causalChain.failureMode: large producers keep expanding and delay supply contraction

causalChain.mechanism: Only a sustained hog-price recovery above company cost can restore margins.
causalChain.failureMode: cost inflation or continued oversupply prevents margin repair

directWinners: lowest-cost breeders after a verified cycle trough
losers: high-cost leveraged breeders during the loss phase
falseThemeMatches: breeders chosen only because share prices already fell

aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Lowest-cost large breeder, but June prices had fallen below the then-reported cost line.

earningsSensitivity.base: Q1 profit RMB6.963bn reflects pre-collapse pricing.
earningsSensitivity.favorable: cost falls and hog price recovers sustainably.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: loss phase deepens before supply exits.

selectionComparison.rationale: No company has a realized or quantitatively bridged earnings trough by cutoff.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Breeder equities had de-rated sharply over 60d, but recent stabilization coincided with policy reserve support rather than verified margin recovery.
expectations.thesisExpectation: A true trough would require capacity exit and a durable hog-price/cost reset.
expectations.measurableGap: The missing variable is realized future supply contraction and company margin inflection.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: No selection: share-price de-rating and policy support are not substitutes for an earnings trough.

bearCase: The apparent price bottom is only a policy bounce; large-producer expansion keeps supply high and losses deepen.

caveats: No post-cutoff outcome used before lock.

nextResearchActions: Keep No selection until survival, capacity exit and realized margin inflection are auditable.
